title: Tom Sunic - Videos
description:
Tomislav Sunić, politolog, publicist i bivši diplomat. Ovdje su izresci iz mojih intervjua i predavanja na hrvatskom, engleskom, francuskom i njemačkom: o Europi i Americi, identitetu i migracijama, Titu i Jugoslaviji, liberalizmu i onome što dolazi poslije njega. Kratki isječci za brzi pregled, dulji za cijelu misao. Autor knjiga Homo Americanus, Against Democracy and Equality i Postmortem Report.

Tomislav Sunić, political scientist, author and former diplomat. Clips from my interviews and talks in Croatian, English, French and German: on Europe and America, identity and migration, Tito and Yugoslavia, liberalism and what comes after it. Shorts for the point, longer cuts for the whole argument. Author of Homo Americanus, Against Democracy and Equality and Postmortem Report.
